metadata.description: Hi5 Success OS: A suite of Claude plugins for YouTube growth, business planning, content repurposing, and marketing execution.

plugins.name: content-os
plugins.description: YouTube-first content creation and repurposing system. Research competitors, plan content, write scripts, repurpose into blog posts, and generate platform-specific social captions, all from one content engine.

plugins.name: business-os
plugins.description: Business planning, goal setting, and performance review tools for entrepreneurs and small business owners.

plugins.name: marketing-os
plugins.description: Email, newsletter, SEO, LinkedIn, website copy, landing pages, and case study tools for consistent marketing execution.

plugins.name: real-estate-os
plugins.description: Real estate only skills for agents, teams, and brokers. Run your CRM by conversation, prepare for listing appointments, launch listings, keep sellers informed, run files from contract to keys, plan your day, keep past clients close, prospect expireds, FSBOs, and farms, guide buyers and renters, write compliant ad packs, practice hard conversations, and support rentals, investors, commercial, and land, with Fair Housing, texting consent, and approval-first guardrails built in.
